caption: The drawing depicts a wooden four-drawer chest placed against a light background, with each drawer having two oval-shaped metal handles. The wood is colored with shades of brown, and the handles have a golden hue. On top of the chest, there is a flat white surface, on which two tall silver candlesticks with white candles are symmetrically positioned near the edges. In between the candlesticks, there is a small rectangular, light-colored box with a blue ribbon. Mounted above the chest on the wall is an oval mirror with an ornate, gilded gold frame featuring floral and scroll designs. The mirror reflects part of the opposite wall and ceiling, as well as a garment hanging in the reflection, rendered in blue tones. The composition is centered on the chest and mirror, with the objects arranged in a balanced and symmetrical manner. The background is plain and uncolored, emphasizing the furniture and objects.
title: Chest of Drawers
